column1: # Language keys that do not follow the language defaults (DEFAULT_*) on their own, and the role each one gets
# (see ROLES in generate_theme.py). Every other language key is left out on purpose: it is marked as inherited (see
# fallback_keys.tsv), so the IDE colours it through its fallback key, all languages follow the DEFAULT_* colours, and
# changes to Language Defaults reach them too.
#   - keys without a fallback key, or whose fallback looks wrong in this palette (keys in CSS, .env, HTTP...);
#   - "inherit": keys left to the IDE. With a fallback key they are marked as inherited, so that the fallback applies
#     instead of the colours Darcula / Islands (or a plugin, for Darcula) give them; the others (log levels, hints,
# read_language_keys.py lists the keys that still need a role. Format: key<TAB>role.
